speed_up.name: Speed Up
speed_up.description: Increases the movement speed of the snake by pressing selected key.

slow_down.name: Slow Down
slow_down.description: Reduces the movement speed of the snake by pressing selected key.

extra_life.name: Extra Life
extra_life.description: Gives you one extra chance after losing in arcade mode.

coin_chance.name: Coin Chance
coin_chance.description: Increases the chance for coins to appear.

meat.name: Meat
meat.description: Unlocks a special food type for the snake. This food gives 2 points when eaten.

floor_selection.name: Board Themes
floor_selection.description: Allows you to choose different board themes.
